title: Mon Cal Cruiser
text:
When Played: Choose one:
Attack with a unit. It gets +2/+0 for this attack.
Look at an opponent's hand. You may discard a card from it. If you do, they draw a card.
rules: If you choose the first option of Mon Cal Cruiser's "When Played" ability, you must attack with a unit, if able. Units must be ready in order to attack.
